reviews.text: I had a very bad experience with Valeria Méndez; her customer service was very poor, she was very inattentive to me. I believe it is important that she improves her attitude and customer service.

I enrolled my dog ​​Draco in the Naples Canine Intelligence program, and ever since Dr. Valeria Méndez Roca (who I don't know if she's a doctor because I don't see her professional license) started working there, she's been very rude to me.

I paid thirty-something thousand pesos for my dog ​​Draco's training, and on October 16, 2026, Draco arrived home and started having loose stools, even though his stomach had been fine the morning I left him. It's likely something they gave him at Canine Intelligence upset his stomach. I took him to his training on October 17, 2026, and they sent me a message saying he had watery stools. I hadn't fed Draco anything that morning, so I hold Canine Intelligence responsible for giving him something that caused the watery stools. I took him to the vet, and they told me he had colitis. I went back to Canine Intelligence to tell them I was bringing him to his training on Monday, and Ms. Valeria Méndez Roca told me I needed a doctor's clearance in a very rude and even mocking manner. I told her he didn't have any illness. The vet told me he had colitis and prescribed probiotics, saying he should continue taking them until he finished his training. I could take him back for treatment.

However, the contract I signed doesn't state in any of its clauses that the dog can't attend canine intelligence training if he's on medication or undergoing treatment, nor does it state in any of its clauses that I have to provide a discharge form for the dog. She told me that's how it was and said it was in a regulation, and I asked if she could show me the regulation. She said no, she didn't have it. I said, "Okay, I'll wait for her to show me the regulation that says I have to provide a discharge form," and then she evaded me, mocking me. I believe that Canine Intelligence has very good trainers, but unfortunately, with this type of person who doesn't provide the good service that all clients deserve, because ultimately we trust them and that's why we sign a contract and accept its terms, and when something happens, they don't respect the contract we signed. The doctor tells me that she's not even in charge, but she's the one making the decisions, from what I can see, because only what appears in my contract, which is signed by both parties, should be recognized. She's violating what the contract says and making her own rules. She even told me she doesn't care if I sue her. All I ask is that the contract clauses be respected; that's why I don't sign a contract, since it's an agreement of wills, and it's not possible that, by violating the contract, they want to add new clauses that aren't in it.

My dog ​​Felix LOVES going to daycare here. The entire staff is friendly, well-trained, and takes great care of all the dogs. As for Felix, from the moment he arrives, he plays nonstop and comes back tired and ready for bed, haha.

Uriel has been very kind and is a genius at training dogs; I highly recommend him if you're looking to bring your dog.

The important thing here is that your dog will be in very good hands and having fun the whole time.

I've tried both daycare and overnight stays, and Felix has done wonderfully with both!

Hi, I'm Sullivan! 🐶 I used to be a very timid little dog and I got super nervous around other dogs and humans. But Canine Intelligence changed my life. Now I get excited every day looking forward to going to daycare to run and play with my friends.

Thank you to everyone at the Naples branch for all the love and for teaching me to be a brave little dog! 🐾
It's a great daycare; my dog ​​loves being there. I like the way they treat him, and the caregivers are very kind and friendly. I appreciate the service.
I highly recommend this place... I've been bringing my dogs for training and daycare for about two years now, and we've always received excellent care and service...

Excellent care for our dog! He loves going, and he's stayed at the boarding facility without any problems. The bathing and nail trimming service is ideal, as is the deworming. We've also taken advantage of the obedience classes, and everything has been great! It's a real pleasure to take Odin and know that he's being looked after at all times.

The service at the Naples branch is excellent; the staff has been very attentive. My dog ​​learned to socialize with other dogs, and her mood and energy levels have improved significantly! Plus, the grooming is very good. Overall, I've had a great experience!
The service was excellent, and Uriel and Dani's kindness and patience were unmatched! I'll definitely be back; Maki is my first choice. Very grateful.
Excellent place!! My pets love going there every day
Excellent service! The dogs have a great time and are always well cared for. Uriel, the manager, is always kind, attentive, and very affectionate with the dogs. 🐶 …
My pet attended the basic training sessions and the trainers are very good.
Their service is very professional. My dogs grew very fond of the manager, Uriel; he always works with a good attitude and is very kind.
They take very good care of the dogs, giving them plenty of attention so they don't get bored, and they're always playing with each other after training.
I highly recommend coming here; they provide excellent service, especially Uriel. My dogs love it! 💕
They always treat Don Ru so well, great service and attention, they love him a lot and that's always appreciated. A place where I like to leave him ❤️
Excellent Ulises, thank you very much for your intelligence.
They should state from the beginning that they don't accept dogs over 8 years old. They just wasted my time and now I have to find another place.
Great disappointment; the responsibility towards animals is highly questionable.
Terrible service, the worst you'll find in Mexico City. Avoid these awful places; there are much better options. This is the worst!

Dante is the happiest dog every time I take him. He's been going Monday through Friday for three years now, and the treatment and care have been excellent. I receive photos and updates every week, which gives me a lot of peace of mind.

Plus, it's a really comprehensive service: they help me with everything, from his vaccinations to his monthly baths, always attentive to his needs. I'm so happy and grateful for the love, attention, and care they give Dante. 🐾❤️
Excellent place, where my dog ​​enjoys playing with the other dogs and the caretakers

We took our dog to obedience training and saw a huge change.

Now he gets along well with other dogs, although he still pulls sometimes. Walks are much calmer, and we have an emotionally balanced dog at home.

Uriel has been very patient with him, and the women who care for them at the doggy daycare love him.

Cooper gets so excited to go play with his friends.

We decided to enroll him in daycare from Monday to Friday because we realized how much better Cooper's life was playing with other dogs.
The best thing was the trust they instilled in us when we left, and they kept us informed about how my dogs were doing the whole time, and they were happy and well cared for.
Excellent service from the manager and his staff; they are very kind and attentive to the dogs. I highly recommend their grooming service; they made my little one look beautiful! 🐶❤️‍🩹
This is where they fail to help people who have been bitten by their dogs. They should be providing care.

Joel Juárez, these are the exact words of his staff: "We do not train or educate dogs. Please do not contact us again." If they treat people with such professionalism, I can't imagine how they treat someone who can't speak like our dogs.
Excellent service and attention from all the staff. Uriel, who trained my pitbull puppy, is very friendly and affectionate with the dogs.
Excellent place, everyone is very friendly, and my dog ​​Micah loves going there. I highly recommend this branch of Canine Intelligence. I feel very safe and at ease leaving him there.
Always very attentive.

Excellent service! Our dog is very hyperactive, but with Uriel's training and the care the staff has given him, he's become an obedient and happy dog ​​who loves playing with the other dogs. The daycare service is also very good; they take excellent care of our Cooper. 100% recommended.
All good
Excellent service

I've been at the doggy daycare for three days with my dog, and everything has been great. Since I arrived, Uriel has been incredibly kind and patiently explained everything, including the protocol for helping my dog ​​adjust to the pack during his first few days. Something I've really appreciated is how organized they are. They respond to messages quickly, they've sent me photos and videos of my dog, and the whole team is very attentive.

Once I've been there longer, I'll give another update on my impressions of the daycare, but for now, I'm very happy, and my dog ​​is happy too! Thanks to Uriel, Yiré, and the whole team! 🐶
Dubby was in basic training, his trainer was really good, they make the new tenants part of the family, I stopped taking him because of a change of residence.

My dog ​​is happy at the doggy daycare. Uriel, the manager, is incredibly kind to him and always willing to help in any way he needs. I feel very reassured knowing he's in charge. All the staff are very friendly and treat my dog ​​with great care and affection. Excellent service, I highly recommend it.
They are always very attentive to the dogs, and they are very kind.

I honestly thought everything was fine. I left my dog ​​there for only her second time, and she came back home extremely scared and it took her more than a whole day to recover. Plus, I left her with a skin problem for which they prescribed medication and applied it for two days. She came back worse, and seeing that, they didn't even bother to put a cone on her paws to stop her from biting them. On top of that, her paws are burned from the synthetic duck they use.

Excellent dog training school. I have a Border Collie puppy, and every morning he's eager to go to school. His behavior has improved tremendously with the training he receives, and he always comes home happy. Highly recommended. 👍 …
They are super professional and attentive. They love dogs and I feel safe leaving them with them.

From day one, Uriel and his entire team treated us with great care and warmth. Our dog learned a lot and has the opportunity to socialize with other dogs, allowing him to channel all his energy in a positive way.

If you're looking for a place with enough space for your pet to be entertained, cared for, and safe,

look no further than Uriel and the entire Canine Intelligence team.

Oh, and they also have a dog spa service. The dogs love it!

Excellent care and attention for the pets. They took perfect care of my dog ​​and kept me informed about his condition every day. You feel very reassured by their staff and facilities. I highly recommend them.

Excellent place, excellent service and care.
I highly recommend it.

Great experience!!
They take great care of the dogs and give them the attention they need.
I took my 5-month-old puppy for training and he's learned a lot.
I can tell he enjoys going because he has no problem staying when I take him!

Uriel is very good at the training he's giving him, he's very patient and treats the dogs very well.

Highly recommended!!

The best in the area, very attentive and friendly. Very clean facilities and plenty of space.

They always have the best attitude, and that's how they welcome my Camila every day.
Very kind!!

Today I feel very sad and disappointed with this company. When we stopped seeing Bris, we thought everything would be the same, but I see now that it isn't. The manager doesn't seem to have a clue what he's doing. I can assure you that my little one doesn't go there with the same enthusiasm as before, and today I find out they aren't even serving breakfast.
What a disappointment. They have a high staff turnover, but seeing Bris there always gave us confidence. Honestly, we don't plan to return, nor do we recommend them, and I'm sharing this information. It's a real shame.

Weeks ago, Pilla got diarrhea, and I took her to the vet at the Del Valle branch, where she was seen and given treatment. However, the treatment DIDN'T WORK. After weeks without improvement, I took my dog ​​to her trusted vet, who was able to improve her condition with the right medication. Currently, Pilla is much better, although she is still undergoing treatment.

Today I decided to take her back so she could resume her doggy daycare and training. And what happened? The young man, Joel Juárez, refused to admit her. When I asked him to give her her medication at 3 p.m., he told me it wasn't possible because it hadn't been prescribed by HIS vet, the same one who, I repeat, DIDN'T cure her. How can this absurd policy be justified?
Trustworthy place with friendly staff
The beauty service is magnificent, they take great care of their clients.

So far, taking our puppy to this canine intelligence center has been a great experience. Before, he was bored at home, but now he comes home exhausted from playing with other dogs all day.

We've always received excellent service and great communication from the entire team.
Excellent

This is the branch where my pet felt most comfortable. Trainer Bris was always very kind and kept a close eye on my dog. She was very professional and achieved great results in a short time. I highly recommend her!

Highly recommended, both the daycare and the training courses. We came to this location because Bris, the trainer, was recommended to us, and she is indeed an excellent trainer. My two dogs were with her for two different levels of training, and their behavior improved significantly. My main problem was them barking at other dogs on walks and their socialization, and Bris helped us solve that. Besides being incredibly professional, she treats the dogs with so much love. Everyone who works there is also very affectionate with them. They even send photos of their dogs when they're boarded and are always very attentive. Completely trustworthy.
Thank you for your rating, Agustin. We're still at your service! 🐶💕 …
My dog ​​loves spending time there. Plus, they have grooming and veterinary services.

My puppy loves being there and gets excited when we're just a few blocks away. Bris is very professional. Marisol, from the grooming salon, is attentive and kind to both humans and dogs.

UPDATE Nov. 2024: Unfortunately, there's a huge staff turnover, and I never recognize who's in charge of my puppy anymore. Bris and Marisol are the only familiar faces; everyone else seems to change every week. This creates distrust. My dog ​​isn't excited anymore, and he's always very anxious when I pick him up. There are too many dogs and too few people in charge. It's a shame. 😪😢

I took my dog ​​to two training courses with them, and Bris, the trainer in charge, was so lovely and dedicated. She made her time there wonderful; my dog ​​was always in good spirits, well cared for, and pampered. Marisol, who gave her weekly maintenance treatments, was also very kind and always kept me updated on her progress. I became good friends with them and had a great time with them, and my dog ​​improved tremendously under their care.
My dog ​​is very well cared for; she always comes back safe and sound whenever I leave her here.

We hired the training and boarding service for my Labrador, Metzi, and everything was great! The training was super effective, and the trainer was an excellent and incredibly kind person! Thank you so much!
Thank you for your rating, Edwyna. We're still here for you 🐶💕 …

They wouldn't accept my dog ​​when I went to drop her off, just hours before I had to leave on a trip. They refused her because she was a "pitbull." When I scheduled the appointment by phone, I mentioned that my dog ​​is a mix with pitbull …

Unacceptable. I called to make an appointment to drop off my dog, and at the last minute they told me they wouldn't accept her because she's a "pitbull," even though she's a mix. They did this to me hours before I had to catch a flight. …
Thank you for your rating Carba, we are still at your service 🐶💕 …
